h: The Unique Portion of Moshe in the Light of Shabbos

p: "Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion."
In the holy Zohar on this parashah
"And thus it is written of Moshe (Shemos 3:2),
'And an angel of Hashem appeared to him
that the praise of Avraham is greater,
for 'angel' is not written of him,
but 'And Hashem appeared to him, etc.'
That is, although it is written
"And Hashem appeared to him" with the Name Havayah,
רַק עַל יְדֵי אַסְפַּקְלַרְיָא דְּלָא נְהַרָא
only through a lens that does not shine;
"But My Name Havayah I did not make known to them":
for although there is mentioned many times
אֵצֶל הָאָבוֹת גַּם כֵּן שֵׁם הֲוָיָ״ה
with the Avos too the Name Havayah,
nevertheless they did not merit Daas,
which is the inner aspect of Keser Elyon,
רַק עַל יְדֵי אַסְפַּקְלַרְיָא דְּלָא נְהַרָא
except through a lens that does not shine,
And likewise it is written immediately (Bereishis 18:3),
and so it is written in the marginal note.
there was no separation in him,
where the cantillation makes no break,
where the cantillation makes a break;
מַה דְּלָא הֲוָה בְּקַדְמַת דְּנָא וְכוּלֵּי
what had not been before, etc."
That is, although it is written (Bereishis 24:1),
"And Avraham was old, advanced in days,"
that is, the three first sefiros,
that the Torah preceded by two thousand years
from what is written, "day by day" (Mishlei 8:30)
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשָׁה יט)
(as it says in Vayikra Rabbah, beginning of 19);
and he merited also the middah of "old,"
"Until Avraham there was no old age"
but that was after his old age,
as soon as he was born,
the lens that shines was with him,
"And she saw him, that he was good."
And therefore it is written of him,
"And an angel of Hashem appeared to him,"
as it says in the holy Zohar
"Behold, I send an angel before you":
all the conduct of this world
And when it says "angel of Hashem,"
it is as it says in the holy Zohar
"Here why is she called an angel?
Rather, when she is sent from above
and say to her: My daughter,
here is for you all that you will need
And this is the meaning of "angel of Havayah":
that there shines to this middah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג סה, ב)
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 246b):
the holy Kingdom did not receive
until it was joined with the Avos;
and when it was joined with the Avos,
it was built into a complete building
the world of the masculine, etc."
And as for its saying "the world of the masculine,"
which is the vav, the middah of Zeir Anpin,
is the glory of the Avos, etc.,
into the World to Come, etc.";
and as the holy Zohar says
that "it was built into a complete building
that there are those who merit the Name Havayah
which is the inner aspect of Keser Elyon,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (מִשְׁלֵי ב, י)
along the lines of what is said (Mishlei 2:10),
knowledge will be pleasant to your soul."
And this is what it says,
"it was built into a complete building
merited the attainment of the entire Name Havayah,
with the crown of the yud,
from the side of the Tree of Life,
לָכֵן אָמַר בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
therefore the holy Zohar mentioned above says
with the crown of the yud.
of whom it is also written "angel of Hashem,"
but there it is written at first
וְשָׁם אֵין הַפֵּירוּשׁ כְּלָל עַל שְׁכִינְתָּא
and there it does not refer at all to the Shechinah,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (תְּהִלִּים צא, יא)
along the lines of what is said (Tehillim 91:11),
"For He will command His angels for you";
and he was like a prophet,
who is also called an angel,
And even Pinchas is called "angel of Hashem,"
"And the angel of Hashem went up"
(as it says in Midrash Rabbah, beginning of Vayikra).
and when it is illuminated from the lens that shines,
at the time he was departing the world
Yaakov after he departed the world;
except when he was close to his passing,
שֶׁאָז הָיָה כְּמוֹ רוּחָא בְּלָא גּוּפָא
when he was like spirit without body;
this is not so of Moshe Rabbeinu,
who was so during his life,
the revelation of the entire Name Havayah,
with the crown of the yud,
as it says (in Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 13):
is the image of the middle pillar
but he was from the inside;
and that one from the soul."
That is, Moshe Rabbeinu, alav hashalom,
merited to be a chariot for the Name Havayah
from the inside, from the soul,
and merited his level during his life, in the body.
This is not so of Yaakov,
who merited his level close to his passing,
as it says in the holy Zohar there.
And this is what is said:
"Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion,
for You called him a faithful servant"

p: וּבְבִלְעָם גַּם כֵּן כְּתִיב (בְּמִדְבַּר כב, כב)
And of Bilam too it is written (Bamidbar 22:22),
"And the angel of Hashem stationed himself, etc.,"
"And Hashem uncovered the eyes of Bilam,
and he saw the angel of Hashem, etc."
אַךְ בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קצג, ב)
But in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 193b)
"'And there has not arisen again a prophet like Moshe'
but among the nations of the world there arose,
But there the holy Zohar explains
that he was in the kelipah
אַךְ כָּאן אִי אֶפְשָׁר לוֹמַר כֵּן
But here one cannot say so,
"And the angel of Hashem said, etc.,
and his words were words of Torah.
And it is brought in the holy Zohar (210b):
for when you open your mouth,
that the Shechinah spoke his words.
וַיְגַל ה׳ אֶת עֵינֵי בִלְעָם וְגוֹ׳
"And Hashem uncovered the eyes of Bilam, etc.":
that for the honor of Yisrael
and showed him for a moment
to see the angel of Havayah,
so that there not be a pretext
for the nations of the world
that they were not given a prophet like Moshe
(וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב מִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ)
(as it says in Midrash Rabbah, beginning of this parashah);
and through this was made clear
the superiority of holy Yisrael over them:
that in Yisrael, when one merits
in the service of Hashem Yisbarach;
וְהוּא אַף שֶׁנִּגְלָה לוֹ מַדְרֵגָה זוֹ
whereas he, although this level was revealed to him,
the moment it was hidden from him
he returned to his old ways,
which they had fenced after the generation of the Flood.
And this is what it says:
"Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion":
that he merited the revelation of the angel of Havayah,
"for You called him a faithful servant,"
"A crown of splendor You placed on his head":
that he merited the middah of Keser Elyon,
which is the crown of Tiferes.
'And you shall make bars of shittim wood,
and it is written, 'and the middle bar, etc.'
two on this side and two on that side,
And this is as it says
in the Tikkunei Zohar mentioned above,
and that one from the inside.
the rest of the others, etc.;
and therefore all the blessings of the Kohen
the spreading of the hand of Moshe
the two arms and the two legs;
and he includes the two arms,
which are the Avos Avraham and Yitzchak,
who are the chariot for Chesed and Gevurah;
and likewise includes the two legs,
for Yaakov and Yosef are as one;
וְהוּא מַבְרִיחַ מִן הַקָּצֶה אֶל הַקָּצֶה
and he runs from end to end,
which also includes the four middos,
Chesed and Gevurah, Netzach and Hod;
is also the middah of Yosef,
the aspect of the one who imparts,
for he is the main one who imparts
words of Torah to Knesses Yisrael.
And Shabbos is "the gift of his portion";
דְּאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קעו, רֵישׁ עַמּוּד ב)
for it is brought in the holy Zohar (Zohar III, beginning of 176b):
of those above and those below, etc."
וּמִשּׁוּם הָכִי נִכְלָל בּוֹ גַּם כֵּן
And therefore there are included in it too
And it says that all the blessings of the Kohen
is the flow of the blessings
"and the spreading of the hand of Moshe
"and from the hills I behold him":
"'and from the hills' with the letter vav,
and it completes the two sides as one;
is never separated from her son
and therefore the vav is included
and it says that she is never separated from her son,
along the lines of what is written
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק א רז, סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (אִדְרָא זוּטָא רצא, רֵישׁ עַמּוּד א)
as it says (Idra Zuta, beginning of 291a);
and Binah includes all three first sefiros,
and this is the entire Name Havayah
that is illuminated in the Shechinah.
fortunate is the portion of Moshe."
